text:
sam: Heads-up: kv-cache hotpath regression in eu-west1 started at ~1705050400. Some clients seeing 5xx on long contexts. Need fast hotfix. Can we cut a shadow release now and force traffic in a short window?

tia: +1 to hotfix. I have a build with a KV fallback branch: v1.4.2-kvfallback. Will it work with current routing?

deploybot: release created: v1.4.2-kvfallback (sha abc123). Canary pipeline queued. See https://release/redwood/1234 :rocket:

morgan: We should avoid a broad canary if latency SLOs are tight. Proposal: shadow release in eu-west1 for 15 minutes, then sweep to 10% if metrics look good.

pm-julia: I approve emergency window as long as we keep customers notified. Post brief release note and rollback plan. :loud_sound:

ops-alex: Standby SRE on pager, will watch kv hit/miss, p50/p95. If error rate >1% for 5m we rollback. I can flip traffic to 10% manually.

sam: deployment command I'll run:
```
deploybot release apply --env eu-west1 --version v1.4.2-kvfallback --traffic shadow:15m
```
Will run in 5 mins unless objections.

tia: no objections. I'll attach a short test script for smoke:
```
curl -X POST https://eu-west1.redwood/api/gen -d '{"prompt":"long context stability test"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```

morgan: tiny nit — document rollback SHA: abc122 (previous stable). If we need to revert:
```
deploybot release revert --to abc122 --force
```

deploybot: Canary started on eu-west1 shadow pool. Canary job id: 202303-sc-789. Logging at https://logs/release/202303-sc-789

ops-alex: Noted anomalies in KV miss rate spike at +2m, but error rate steady. Continuing.

sam: greenlight from ops in 12m, promoting to 10% traffic. Promoting now. :white_check_mark:

pm-julia: notify customers in #support with patch note: short summary, ETA, rollback plan.

deploybot: Promotion complete: v1.4.2-kvfallback -> 10% traffic in eu-west1.

sam: closing loop — keep on-call for 30m and then we'll either rollout or rollback based on perf telemetry. Thanks all. :heart:
